collectorNotes:
I checked these sources directly: the official Hugging Face model card, the technical report PDF (Table 2 matches the model card) and the launch blog footnotes.

What Moonshot's own material reports:
- Terminal-Bench: only TB 2.1 (88.3). This is not recorded.
- OSWorld: OSWorld-Verified 84.8 (not recorded) and OSWorld 2.0 58.3. The OSWorld 2.0 column is not labeled partial or binary. I infer it is the partial score because, in the same table, the GPT-5.5 / GPT-5.6 Sol values (49.5 / 62.6) match the partial scores on the Snorkel board.
- AutomationBench: run on the 600-task public subset, so comparable=false.
- Agents' Last Exam: reports the pass rate, so comparable=false. The comparable Score (avgScore) comes from the ALE official API: Kimi Code 51.58, Claude Code 50.72. I cross-checked against the GPT-6 Astra row in the same API (avgScore 0.5926 = 59.3) to confirm that avgScore is the Score metric.
- FrontierSWE: reports the dominance score 81.2, so comparable=false. The official mean@5 is 25.9.
- CritPt, SciCode, AA-LCR and GDPval-AA v2 (1686 Elo) are AA numbers cited by Moonshot (as of 2026-07-23), so they are recorded as official.

Leaderboards where Kimi K3 is missing:
- tbench.ai TB 4.0 and TB-Science
- Zapier AutomationBench
- Scale HLE (only shows kimi-k2.5)
- Snorkel OSWorld 2.0

Vendor comparison: the leads list none. As an extra check I only looked at the GLM-5.3 Hugging Face card, which includes a Kimi K3 column. I did not check the comparison tables from Qwen, MiMo, Step, Ling or DeepSeek; the DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and GLM-5.3-Flash cards do not mention Kimi.

Vals TB4 17.17 and TB-Science 1.43 are third-party runs (mini-SWE-agent).
verifierSummary: I opened all 28 records' sources and checked the numbers. All 28 are confirmed and none need correcting. The sources were the Kimi K3 HF model card plus the technical report PDF, the GLM-5.3 HF model card, the DeepSWE v1.1 leaderboard-live.json, the FrontierSWE homepage, the Toolathlon homepage (the Toolathlon-Verified table), the ALE /api/demo/leaderboard JSON, and the two Vals AI pages. Key points checked: (1) The Kimi model card footnotes confirm several things. The HLE-Full cells read without tools / with tools in that order. Top-p for HLE-Full is 0.95. DeepSWE is v1.1 run with the Kimi Code harness, and the card also cites 67.3 for mini-SWE-agent on the official board. FrontierSWE is a dominance score (comparable=false is correct). AutomationBench is the 600-task public subset (not the private held-out set, so comparable=false is correct). ALE uses the primary pass-rate metric (comparable=false is correct). SciCode, CritPt, AA-LCR and GDPval-AA v2 are cited from AA as of 2026-07-23. Section 6.1.3 of the technical report says Toolathlon-Verified is cited from the official board as of 2026-07-24. (2) OSWorld 2.0 does not say partial or binary on the card. The OSWorld 2.0 paper abstract (arXiv 2606.29537) gives Opus 4.8 a binary completion rate of 20.6% and a partial score of 54.8%, and GPT-5.5 a binary rate of about 13%. The Kimi table shows Opus 4.8 at 55.7 and GPT-5.5 at 49.5, which matches the partial scale. So 58.3 is very likely a partial score, and comparable=true holds, though this is an inference. (3) The DeepSWE leaderboard JSON (generated_at 2026-09-22) has kimi-k3 / mini-swe-agent / max with pass_at_1=0.68514, n_attempted=451 and n_runs=4, so 68.5 is right. (4) The Toolathlon row sits in the Toolathlon-Verified table (released 2026-06-30, 108 tasks): Kimi K3 (max), Default, 2026-07-16, 76.5 ± 1.9. (5) In the ALE JSON, passRate = passes / splitTasks (43/152 = 0.2829) and avgScore = 0.5158. The Claude Code harness row is 41/152 = 0.2697 and 0.5072. (6) Vals TB4 is Version 4.0, updated 10/7/2026, scored avg@3 (the mean of three full runs), with Kimi K3 at 17.17%. Vals TB-Science was updated 10/8/2026, with Kimi K3 at 1.43%. (7) The GDPval-AA conversions are right: 1686 gives 59.3 and 1682 gives 59.1. (8) In the GLM-5.3 table, Kimi K3 shows HLE w/ Tools 59.8, DeepSWE (v1.1) 67.5, Toolathlon Verified 76.5, ALE-CLI 27.6 (GLM's footnote says 105 tasks with the Claude Code harness), AutomationBench v1.0.6 46.7, and GDPval-AA v2 1682. The footnotes do not say who ran the Kimi K3 HLE or DeepSWE numbers; the 67.5 is the same as Kimi's own Kimi Code result. Files are in source-downloads/dl/k3/, k3pdf/ and lb/.
